areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Sustainability and urban-resilience component with sustainable-drainage pilot plan, devices and compensatory techniques.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Stormwater macro-drainage, a sanitation segment, is the program focus and takes most of the financing.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Sustainable drainage based on artificial retention that mimics the natural hydrological cycle and reduces flood risk.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: Organizational development axis with a territorial information and management system linking an operations center to weather and civil-protection bodies for preventive communication.

areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: Pump-efficiency technology touches the criterion only indirectly, with no further support elsewhere.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Estuary and mangrove preservation is an indirect effect; no actions specifically aimed at biodiversity.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: Claimed business benefits from reduced flooding are an indirect effect; no initiatives that improve the business environment.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Claimed benefit to small commerce is indirect; no direct actions for entrepreneurs or small firms.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: No actions to generate jobs and income for vulnerable populations.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Drainage benefits flooded neighborhoods generally, not directed specifically at low-income groups (indirect effect).

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Proponent itself says the program is not aimed at minorities; no specific inclusion action.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: No youth, gender or race policies.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Environmental education and vocational training actions represent a negligible share of financing.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: No technological innovation actions; studies and projects are not a concrete delivery.

areas.name: Financing arrangements encouraging private participation
areas.reason: No such arrangements; ordinary public procurement is insufficient.
